_LOCAL NEWS_🇱🇰

IRD surpasses 2026 revenue target with over Rs. 2.4 t collected by mid-November
The Inland Revenue Department (IRD) has exceeded its annual revenue target for 2026, collecting Rs. 2,441.9 billion as of 16 November, against a target of Rs. 2,402 billion. Issuing a statement, the Department described the achievement as a significant milestone in the Government’s efforts to strengthen revenue collection. It added that the revenue collected by 16 November was Rs. 491 billion, 115% higher than in the corresponding period of 2025.

Sri Lanka Cabinet approves Rs.500bn worth projects amid criticism over spending
Sri Lanka’s Cabinet of Ministers approved a raft of infrastructure projects worth nearly Rs. 500 billion, Cabinet Spokesman Nalinda Jayatissa said on Tuesday, amid growing criticism over unspent capital spending allocated in 2026 budget. The Cabinet approved Rs. 251.4 billion worth of projects to construct the road section of the first phase of the Ruwanpura Expressway from Kahatuduwa to Ingiriya, including the system interchange.

Sri Lanka Telecom accelerates shift to tech company with AI, 5G, and data center push
Sri Lanka Telecom (SLT-Mobitel) is accelerating its shift from a traditional telecom operator into a technology company, prioritizing artificial intelligence, targeted 5G expansion, and data centers after posting strong profit growth in the first nine months of 2026.The state-run group said it is moving beyond legacy voice and connectivity services into digital products to counter rising competition from global over-the-top (OTT) platforms.
Reference: https://tinyurl.com/y76usbp7

LAUGFS cuts domestic gas prices
LAUGFS Gas PLC, which increased its domestic gas prices with effect from midnight on 13 November, reduced the prices of its domestic gas cylinders yesterday (17), with the 12.5kg cylinder being cut by Rs. 745 to Rs. 5,995 and the 5kg cylinder reduced to Rs. 2,398. The company stated its Board of Directors decided to reduce the prices following a request made by Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development Wasantha Samarasinghe and taking into consideration the difficulties faced by consumers.

Ranjit Page sheds more stake in Cargills Ceylon
Deputy Chairman/Group CEO Ranjit Page has further shed his stake in Cargills Ceylon PLC. As per a disclosure made by the Company to the CSE yesterday, Ranjit on Monday, 16 November sold nearly 7 million shares at Rs. 637 each in a deal worth Rs. 4.45 billion. This was after he sold 6 million shares at Rs. 700 each in August. By end-June 2026, he held 20.38 million shares or 7.9% which had come down to 13 million or 5% by end September.

_Global NEWS_🌍

Dollar holds near 19-month high as data supports case for US rate hikes
The dollar held steady near a 19-month high on Wednesday as US economic data and comments from Federal Reserve officials lent support to the case for interest rate hikes. The yen edged lower ‌even after Japanese trade figures showed exports set a record monthly value in October on strong demand in the semiconductor sector. The Aussie dollar languished near a 10-month low.Data on Tuesday showed US retail sales increased moderately in October, reinforcing expectations for a rate hike next month.

Trading Day: AI trade unwind continues, but Nvidia beats
The AI trade unwind continued on Tuesday, pushing global stocks lower ahead of Nvidia's quarterly earnings and as investors prepared for Anthropic's stock market launch later in the week, while solid US retail sales and hawkish comments from Fed officials kept alive expectations that interest rates are headed higher.
